{07 07 00}Ugh.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} I feel like somebody

messages.en:
{07 07 00}Don't worry. I'm not
contagious. At least, I

steal it away from me!{01 00 00 05 00} How
cruel.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} {01 08 00}Achoo!

{07 15 00}How could you be so mean
to someone so sick!

{07 14 00}Ohh!{01 00 00 14 00} See kraam mõjub
kiiresti! Ma ei tunne enam,
et ma minestaksin!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}From now on, I'll be sure to
check the expiration dates
on the food in my fridge!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Nüüdsest kontrollin ma
kindlasti oma külmkapis
toidu säilivusaegu!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Thank you! It's nice to have
a friend who doesn't run
screaming when I get sick.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Aitäh! Tore, kui on sõber,
kes ei jookse karjudes
ära, kui ma haigeks jään.

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}Ever since you brought me
that {ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00}, I've felt so
much better, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Thanks for caring about
me, which is more than I
can say for SOME friends.
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}Sellest ajast, kui sa tõid
mulle {ff 00 00 07}rohtu{ff 00 00 00}, tunnen ma end
palju paremini, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Aitäh, et sa minust hoolid,
mida ei saa MÕNE teise
sõbra kohta öelda.
